mentions.name: SIP4AI
mentions.description: A self-hostable VOIP soft-phone that puts AI on the other end of the line instead of a human. Users register a SIP line and let AI take the calls, working with an existing phone system so AI can be added as a line without replacing everything.
mentions.problem: Adding AI call handling normally means having to replace the whole phone system; SIP4AI works with existing systems instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on SIP4AI [1] (a VOIP soft-phone where AI is on the other end, not a human). You can self-host it, register a SIP line, and let AI take the calls.
